chronology.purpose: Close execution-subject, scheduler-terminal, harvest and publication-authority provenance before the first outcome-bearing Paper-IV Phase-2 A100 job.

gaps: submission records the current HEAD but does not detach to an explicit requested subject, require a clean tracked checkout, or verify the frozen Phase-2 protocol/runner/generator/admission blobs before sbatch
there is no scheduler-observed harvest path that binds the completed job, exact subject and raw result bundle before canonical admission

the existing sbatch wrapper uses set -e around a runner whose return code 1 can represent a complete registered scientific harm terminal, so a valid scientific negative can be conflated with scheduler/infrastructure failure

the raw runner field paper4_standalone_authorized can become true after a Phase-2 efficacy terminal even though standalone Paper-IV authorization still requires issue #462 plus fresh shared-substrate/generalization evidence; this raw field is therefore non-authoritative and must not propagate through harvest

runner_terminal_contract.rule: A complete FINAL_RECEIPT.json with a registered terminal and compatible local runner code is a completed scientific execution even when the local runner code is nonzero. The sbatch transport validates the pair and exits scheduler-success only after that validation. A crash or code/terminal mismatch remains infrastructure failure.

publication_and_authority_boundary.phase2_positive_can_authorize: training-policy consideration only through the canonical raw-bundle admission and cost gate
publication_and_authority_boundary.standalone_gate_remains: issue #462; #467/#468 remain fresh downstream experiments and may not be inferred from Phase-2 metadata
